description: This file defines TypeScript interfaces, constants, and utility functions related to MCP tools and server configurations within a React or TSX component-based application. It includes types for teams, authentication types, transport methods, MCP tools, server info, and response structures used for interactions with MCP services.

methods.name: handleTransport
methods.description: Returns a string representing the transport method; defaults to 'sse' if input is null or undefined.

methods.name: handleAuth
methods.description: Returns the provided authentication type, or 'none' if input is null or undefined.
